root_cause: Canonical RPC daily CTA rollup matched legacy event_type cta_click but website producers emitted primary_cta_click, secondary_cta_click and money_link_click. Netlify growth replay additionally treated HTTP 200 as persisted without validating actual matching Supabase RPC receipt.

observed_evidence.privacy: No customer details, credentials, addresses, contact information or raw telemetry in repository

fix: Existing RPC counts actual consented CTA aliases with conservative non-robot idempotent reconciliation; existing Netlify writers reject non-matching event/outcome RPC receipts; existing backend adds read-only service-role evidence views.
prevention_rule: Every producer event_type must be included in rollup contract and tested. 202 is queued only; mark persisted only with matching datahub/table/event or outcome ID, queue ID and stored XOR deduped RPC flags. Form-intent is not lead; send is not order; revenue requires independent provider proof.
terminal_rule: Production GREEN only after protected Required, BRAIN, CodeQL, exact SHA merge, migration ledger/readback, consent-verified real browser receipt, persisted Supabase event, reconciled dashboard, and independent order proof. No duplicate scheduler; retain unmet obligations.
